context.transcript:
Good evening everyone.
It is my great pleasure to host the ESPA Foundation Awards Ceremony.
As you know, each year the Foundation recognizes practical innovations that offer great benefits to society.
I'm pleased to present the first award this evening to a mechanical engineer, Sonia Johnson.
Sonia has applied her engineering skills to design a low-cost system to filter drinking water for use in remote areas of the world.
The design is especially notable because it uses materials that are readily available in the areas where the system is needed.
context.transcript_translation:
大家晚上好。
我很荣幸能主持 ESPA 基金会颁奖典礼。
如您所知，每年该基金会都会表彰为社会带来巨大益处的实用创新。
我很高兴地宣布今晚第一个奖项授予机械工程师 Sonia Johnson。
Sonia 将她的工程技能应用于设计一套低成本的系统，用于过滤世界偏远地区的饮用水。
这项设计尤其值得注意，因为它使用了在需要该系统的地区容易获得的材料。
